name: Nakano (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nakano ward emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Nakano, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1940.

features.role: Nakano ward emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character with a pointed top
